This broad and somewhat non-linear background demonstrates Felix's analytical and results-oriented approach to all aspects of life, including wealth management.

representative.name: Michael S.
representative.bio:
From the streets of Detroit originally, I grew up always dreaming of doing better. I felt out of place, seeing others get all sorts of stuff come to them, while I worked hard for everything I had. I promised myself as a kid that I would do whatever I could to help people reach their dreams, because I knew what it felt like not to have help. I've helped set up non-profits and businesses from the ground up, served in the Army, played hockey, raised a son as a single father, and learned all sorts of skills, just so that I could help to make the world a bit easier for anyone else trying to do the same. I just hope to bring a little bit of order to all the chaos in the world.

Fun fact: I have "pet" raccoons, and social media dedicated just to them.

from_this_business.specialties: Stevanus Financial Services started on a simple premise: bring financial services and education to the average person and small business. Low monthly rates for bookkeeping and everything else, the only service above $75 is website design. Offering both a remote and hybrid environment, so that you can always talk in person about your and your business' future. Initial consultations are always free, so let's talk about your goals and dreams, and work together to get you there!

{"content": {"style": "body2-text-regular", "value": "TurboTax Deluxe Desktop 2025 is not worth a red cent.

I am attempting to run it on Windows 11, as recommended by TurboTax.

1.  The advertising misrepresented the product, giving the buyer the clear impression that it will import retirement account distributions (1099-R), interest and dividends (1099-Int, 1099-Div), and brokerage data, including stock and bond sales, as the Deluxe version did in previous years.  However, I discovered:

  a.  That it CLAIMS to import only summary data of stock and bond sales, by 1099-B.

  b.  Multiple attempts failed to import the broker's 1099-R's, 1099-Int's, 1099-Div's, or 1099-B's.  I confirmed that the brokerage account permitted data-sharing, and have had no difficulty with a full download in previous years.  In this case the download screen indicated "Download successful!" but no data was in fact imported into TurboTax.

  c.  An attempt to import a simple 1099-R from a separate retirement account also failed; with the indication "Something went wrong."

  d.  Three hours of help calls to TurboTax at 888-777-3066 over as many days were unable to resolve these issues.  Furthermore, the Turbotax ScreenShare did not permit the technician to even see the desktop program on my screen.

2.  Previous-year versions of TurboTax Deluxe permitted entering details of charitable cash contributions.  A TurboTax answer to an on-line query, and the 2025 version interior prompts, give the misleading impression that this convenience is still available.  It is not.

3.  I could apply for a refund, but then I would have to re-do the work to date, and the help technicians were unable to approve a free upgrade to TurboTax Premier - even if Premier would work.

My impression:  TurboTax has written both its advertising copy for Deluxe 2025, and its interior directions and prompts, to give the impression of functions that do not exist (2 above), or do not reliably work (1 above).  The copy appears to have been carefully written to induce a purchase of Deluxe with a view to sell an upgrade to Premier.

Avoid TurboTax.  Buy something else.", "color": "grayscale-black-regular", "textAlignment": "left"}, "showMoreLabel": {"style": "body2-text-semibold", "value": "Read more", "color": "ui-teal-dark"}, "showLessLabel": {"style": "body2-text-semibold", "value": ""}, "truncationConfig": {"truncationCount": 3, "truncationCountType": "line"}, "padding": {"top": 8, "bottom": 0, "left": 0, "right": 0}, "onClick": [{"action_type": "consumer.mobile-analytics.log-analytic.v1", "parameters": "{"iri": "brand/review/readmore/click", "category": "event", "parameters": "{\"business_id_encid\": \"Ugo5flgm4Mawu4pbZrZsFQ\", \"brand_biz_encid\": \"XzuFCqRiHjs3rYh8ium_9w\", \"search_request_id\": \"3ee79cbe629e234e\", \"source\": \"brand_ad_serp\", \"url_alias\": \"turbotax\", \"is_advertiser\": \"true\"}"}", "identifier": "ddZAhYVbSpQW7ppMegxrUn-log-analytic-v1"}]}

{"content": {"style": "body2-text-regular", "value": "1251 N Eddy St Office 25 / 031 should be easy enough to find. Wrong! The building located at 1251 N Eddy St. is a building filled with leased offices. You enter the building in a side \"alley\" entrance and immediately see a large sign with many business names (and what floor they are on) next to an elevator. Turbo Tax is not on this sign. You can take the elevator to floors 2,3 or 4. Again, no signs at any of the elevator exits for Turbo Tax. After going back outside and circling the building to make sure there are no other entrances and asking several passersby we go back to the side entrance and decide to try the second floor first. I decide to try the first unlocked plain glass office door on the 2nd floor to once again ask anybody I see if they have any idea where the Turbo Tax office might be located. There is nobody behind the reception desk, but there is someone visible around the corner doing their best to avoid any eye contact with me. There are two people in the waiting area and I recognize that I've already asked one of them. Meanwhile my husband is in the hallway calling the Turbo Tax number and because this is not the number to the local office he is being told that they will try and reach someone at the local office to give us directions. Suddenly an individual enters this office and asks, \"Who's next?\" The two people sitting in the waiting area say nothing, so I show him my phone with the Turbo Tax email showing their address and say \"I'm just trying to find an office.\" He asks again, \"Who's next?\" then turns and goes behind the reception desk and down a hallway. He quickly returns and says, \"Joe will meet with you shortly.\" What???!!!! I knock on the glass door to the hallway and tell my husband that I think this is the place. He hangs up the call and comes in almost the same time Joe comes out from the hallway behind the desk and welcomes us. We asked why no signs to get us there? Why no directions in the email to confirm our appointment? Why no local phone number to call in the email? We were told that he had no control over any of that. Really??!! We said, \"No!\"  and left to find someone competent in life skills to help us with our taxes. As a side note, the person behind the desk told us that he puts up with this \"all day long.\" Shouldn't the light bulb come on and someone from that office do something proactive to avoid this situation? My suggestion would be a phone call with verbal directions, written directions with the appointment confirmation email or even a hand made sign on the glass door on the second floor office entrance. So much for arriving 15 minutes early for our scheduled appointment. It took the entire 15 minutes to wander around aimlessly getting very frustrated!", "color": "grayscale-black-regular", "textAlignment": "left"}, "showMoreLabel": {"style": "body2-text-semibold", "value": "Read more", "color": "ui-teal-dark"}, "showLessLabel": {"style": "body2-text-semibold", "value": ""}, "truncationConfig": {"truncationCount": 3, "truncationCountType": "line"}, "padding": {"top": 8, "bottom": 0, "left": 0, "right": 0}, "onClick": [{"action_type": "consumer.mobile-analytics.log-analytic.v1", "parameters": "{\"iri\": \"brand/review/readmore/click\", \"category\": \"event\", \"parameters\": \"{\\\"business_id_encid\\\": \\\"Ugo5flgm4Mawu4pbZrZsFQ\\\", \\\"brand_biz_encid\\\": \\\"XzuFCqRiHjs3rYh8ium_9w\\\", \\\"search_request_id\\\": \\\"3ee79cbe629e234e\\\", \\\"source\\\": \\\"brand_ad_serp\\\", \\\"url_alias\\\": \\\"turbotax\\\", \\\"is_advertiser\\\": \\\"true\\\"}\"}", "identifier": "mNPSmHfa3ZhgDVjhCrW9L4-log-analytic-v1"}]}
